svg.text: What the strategy trades — a volume-confirmed candlestick breakout
Two coil-then-break patterns. Buy on the breakout only when volume surges; risk is the pattern low; wins trail out under rising pivot lows.

g.text: A big bar, then a small green bar coiling inside it, then a breakout.
A strong bar, two small bars coiling inside its body, then a breakout.

svg.text: Real winners the pattern caught — out-of-sample, volume-confirmed (VRR ≥ 2.5), US names
Illustrative trades from the backtest · costs included · magnitudes are survivorship-tilted upper bounds — shown to display the setup, not as a return forecast.
Preliminary results — first multi-market backtest, one unoptimized rule, costs included

All five markets net-positive on a single rule · each market a $100k book at 0.5% risk/trade · first-run figures are survivorship-tilted upper bounds and the recent window is weaker — verification comes next.
From idea to live strategy — the full path, and where this sits today
A promising first run — turned into a concrete, testable system. The roadmap above is how it gets pressure-tested before any live capital.
